in_sanskrit.name: Shau
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goodness, Truth, Grace
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Shau एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Shau is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shauka' which means 'goodness, truth, grace'. It is also associated with the god Shiva, symbolizing the purification of the soul and the attainment of spiritual enlightenment.
